BiblicalUsage: At the dedication of the house of God, Ezra records twelve he-goats offered for a sin offering for all Israel, according to the number of the tribes. The Aramaic word is clan or tribe, and here it counts the whole people: twelve tribes, twelve goats, one offering.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the twelve goats preach unity, for Israel was scattered and divided but the offering counted all of them, and I hold that God still counts His whole people.
